caption: The drawing shows a bouquet-like arrangement of various flowers and leaves emerging from a decorated cornucopia-shaped vessel. The vessel is colored with alternating blue and white stripes. The bouquet contains one large central pink flower, several blue cluster-shaped flowers with small white accents, smaller pink flowers, and various green leaves with distinct veining. Some leaves are large and dark green with noticeable shading, while others are smaller and lighter. Thin, winding stems and tendrils interlace through the composition, with a background of delicate, thin, brownish-pink stems and clusters of small flowers with light pink petals. The drawing is framed with a double-bordered wooden frame, the inner border golden-yellow and the outer border brownish-black. The entire artwork is on a browned, aged paper set against a wider field of off-white or cream paper. Handwritten writing is visible near the bottom of the drawing.
title: Watercolor Painting
